projects.title: Lead Qualification & Scoring Agent
projects.client: WholsDésir — The Lifestyle Connoisseur (media agency, custom Agency Management Platform software)
projects.description: Designed a lead scoring agent that grades inbound prospects A through F on a weighted model of verified budget (35%), purchasing authority (30%), immediate need (25%) and timeline urgency (10%), routing top-tier leads to account executives within 60 seconds — while a consent gate, competitor screening and a human-in-the-loop rule let it draft outreach but never send it.
projects.live_url: TODO: publish - demo is built and ready at portfolio/lead-score-demo.html

demo.status: built and logic-tested, not yet published
demo.note: Single-file, zero-dependency page. Implements the spec's consent gate, quarantine screening, ICP filters, 35/30/25/10 weighted scoring, A-F bands, score decay and routing rules. Six presets verified against expected grades. Opens straight in a browser or serves as-is from GitHub Pages or Netlify.
presets: Decayed lead (grade downgraded after 30 days idle)

highlights: Weighted A–F grading: 35% verified budget, 30% authority, 25% need, 10% timeline
Human-in-the-loop by design — the agent scores and pre-drafts, all prospect contact stays with a human AE
Consent gating: unconsented submissions are rejected and persist no personally identifiable information
Competitor, disposable-domain and bot-pattern screening routes to a quarantine queue
Score decay — one letter grade after 30 days inactive; C-grade prospects re-evaluated every 60 days
Full Prisma schema designed across Lead, Interaction and RejectionEvent with a 7-state status enum
Won/lost calibration loop to tune scoring weights from real deal outcomes

projects.title: SEO Intelligence Agent
projects.description: Built and benchmarked an SEO audit agent that grades website health across local, e-commerce, and SaaS domains, passing 15 of 15 assertions on a self-authored evaluation suite while refusing to invent metrics it cannot verify.
highlights: 15/15 assertions passed across 3 evals (100% pass rate)
Tested on local grooming, e-commerce product pages, and construction SaaS
Separates Observed vs Inferred findings and flags data gaps instead of fabricating numbers

projects.title: AI OS Scaffold
projects.description: Built a file-based agent operating system — a JSON skill registry, a persistent memory store, and 13 modular system prompts that route incoming requests to the right skill.
highlights: 13 skills behind a single trigger-phrase registry
Config, memory, and skills fully separated for independent editing

projects.title: Two-Tier Skill Routing
projects.description: Extended the AI OS with a router that indexes 188 skills from 12 external repos, pulling them in as pinned submodules instead of copying their code.
highlights: 223 SKILL.md files collapsed to 188 distinct skills
Kept third-party code out of the repo — 0.1 MB pushed instead of 566 MB
Skips test fixtures and per-agent packaging duplicates automatically

accuracy_notes: lead-scoring-agent: Section 13 of the spec still contains <placeholder> config values, and there is no code, database or deployment. Describe it as a design or specification, not a shipped product - a reviewer who asks to see it running will find nothing.

seo-intelligence-agent: the 15/15 figure comes from benchmark.json, which records with_skill runs only. There is no without_skill baseline, so the evals show the skill works but do not prove it beats no skill at all.
